description: Update an existing calendar event by id. Supply changed fields in body, such as scheduled_at, timezone, event_title, or scheduled_content_text. This overwrites stored event fields and can change the publication schedule; returns the updated event.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.
